title: Coreintegra Consulting Services IPO Details
intro:
Coreintegra Consulting IPO is a book build issue of ₹21.99 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 28.19 lakh shares of ₹21.99 crore.

Coreintegra Consulting IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and will close on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Coreintegra Consulting IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Coreintegra Consulting IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Coreintegra Consulting IPO is set issue price band at ₹74 to ₹78 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,49,600 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,74,400.

Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries Brokers Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Purva Sharegistry (India) Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Rikhav Securities Ltd.

Refer to Coreintegra Consulting IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2009, Core Integra Consulting Services Limited is an integrated human resource solutions provider offering staffing, payroll outsourcing, labour law compliance, HR advisory, vendor management, and proprietary HR-Tech and Reg Tech platforms under one umbrella. The human resource services offer targeted support in recruitment, staffing, payroll processing, HR advisory including labour compliances, licenses and registration, policy drafting, just in time hiring solutions, retainership and assurance services which are designed to support regulatory compliance for businesses.

The company offer tech- driven solutions to streamline and digitize human resource management through our proprietary platforms CoreX and Core Pay under HR Tech, and Ctrl-F and Core -PFT under Reg Tech.

The company successfully provided our diverse range of services to more than 600 customers across more than 30 industries, spanning presence 23 states and 4 union territories by serving more than 1500 client locations through the network of 7 branch offices.
As of August 31, 2026, the company had 12166 employees.
strengths: Technology Platforms built in-house covering all aspects of the human resource value chain
Deep domain expertise delivered through comprehensive solutions across industries
Wide geographic presence with efficient labour law compliance capabilities
Established long term relationship with clients leading to recurring business
Experience of our Promoter and management team

faqs.question: How to apply in Coreintegra Consulting IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Coreintegra Consulting IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Coreintegra Consulting IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Coreintegra Consulting IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Coreintegra Consulting IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Coreintegra Consulting IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Coreintegra Consulting IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Coreintegra Consulting IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the Coreintegra Consulting IPO allotment status .
